headline: Blue Blends (I) Limited: Board Approves IBC Resolution Plan Implementation
sum: Blue Blends (I) Limited's board approved implementation of an NCLT-sanctioned resolution plan, cancelling promoter and promoter-group equity and reducing public shareholder holdings with allotment of fresh equity to approved allottees. The approval follows the order of the Adjudicating Authorities and the Approved Resolution Plan under the IBC framework.
implication: Share-class cancellation and dilution in IBC exits underscore the priority hierarchy for secured creditors and financial stakeholders over existing equity; public shareholders face material write-down or conversion risk in insolvency outcomes.
detail: Acting in accordance with an Approved Resolution Plan and order from the Adjudicating Authorities, the board approved three key actions: (1) complete cancellation of all equity held by the existing promoter and promoter group; (2) reduction of all equity held by public shareholders as of the record date (17 April 2026); and (3) allotment of fully paid-up fresh equity shares to approved allottees under the resolution plan and the Adjudicating Authority's order. This sequence is typical of IBC restructurings where sponsor-led resolution plans result in 100% write-down of founder equity and dilution of public shareholders to accommodate creditor recovery and resolution finance.
